# Planview Copilot - product overview (Avantra summary)

> Demonstration content summarised by Avantra from publicly available Planview positioning. Pending curator verification against the official product page and datasheet. Contains no pricing.

## Overview

Generative-AI assistant for Planview solutions providing insights and assistance within the products.

Also known as: Copilot, Planview Advisor. Solution areas: Cross-portfolio AI. Deployment: SaaS.

## Capabilities

- **AI assistance** - a core capability of Planview Copilot: Generative-AI assistant for insights and automation inside the product. Note: Availability per product, region and licence to be confirmed with Planview.

## Implementation considerations

- Review the customer's AI governance policy and data residency requirements before enabling.
